theme: Light & Dreamy (Blush Pink, Soft Lavender, Champagne Cream, Warm Mulberry Text)

styles.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-normal tracking-tight leading-[1.08] text-[#2D1527]
styles.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#2D1527]

layout_sections.name: Floating Crystal Navigation Bar
layout_sections.description: Sticky backdrop-blur navigation with audio toggle sound effect, quick jump links, and interactive surprise trigger button.
components: Jump Links: Countdown, Chapters, Memories, Wishes

layout_sections.name: Kinetic Dreamy Hero
layout_sections.description: Masked line-by-line typography reveal with subtle floating balloons and soft ambient light mesh.
key_features: Subtitle: 'Celebrating another trip around the sun'

layout_sections.name: Live September 26 Countdown
layout_sections.description: Elegant clock counter tracking Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds until September 26 celebration with festive confetti trigger when active.

layout_sections.name: Birthday Chapters / Story Manifesto
layout_sections.description: Numbered editorial accordions or staggered story cards highlighting traits, milestones, and heartfelt chapters dedicated to Parul.
chapters: Chapter 01 — The Light in Every Room
Chapter 03 — A Year of Big Dreams & Laughter
Chapter 04 — Wishes for the Journey Ahead

layout_sections.name: Editorial Ribbon Marquee
layout_sections.description: Slow, organic drifting low-contrast marquee text featuring sweet birthday mantras.
layout_sections.content: ✨ WISHING PARUL THE MAGICAL YEAR EVER • SEPTEMBER 26 • CELEBRATE LOVE & LAUGHTER • RADIANT VIBES ALWAYS ✨

layout_sections.name: Interactive Memory Wall (Bento Grid)
layout_sections.description: Asymmetric Bento Grid photo gallery with custom frame styling, light zoom effects, and memory quotes.

layout_sections.name: Interactive Surprise Zone (Balloon Pop & Confetti Cannon)
layout_sections.description: Interactive floating balloons that users can click to pop with sound & gentle confetti release, plus a 'Make a Wish' virtual candle lighting moment.

layout_sections.name: Interactive Wishes & Message Wall
layout_sections.description: Live wish feed where friends can leave personalized birthday notes, choose an emoji/color badge, and submit wishes dynamically stored in backend API.
form_fields: Relationship / Tag (e.g., Bestie, College Pal, Family)

layout_sections.name: Editorial Heartfelt Footer
layout_sections.description: Deep rose/mulberry contrasting footer section with large decorative serif text 'Made with love for Parul' and quick restart surprise buttons.

animations.entrance: Staggered fade-up with spring physics (stiffness: 100, damping: 15)
animations.balloon_float: Continuous smooth Y-axis floating sine wave (duration: 6s - 10s)
animations.confetti: Custom canvas-confetti burst on wish submit and balloon pop

testing_conventions.rule: Every interactive element must feature data-testid using kebab-case

instructions_to_main_agent: Build an Awwwards-level dreamy, elegant single-page celebration experience for Parul.
Ensure generous padding (p-8 to p-16), soft pastel colors, and rich typography hierarchy.
Use framer-motion for smooth scroll reveals and interactive balloon floating physics.
Implement the live wish wall with dynamic state and seamless submission.
Strictly follow data-testid naming standards across all key UI components.
